7.4.1.9.2 Enumeration Data Types
[SWS_CM_10361]
Serializing Enumeration Data Type ⌈Enumeration Data
Type shall be serialized according to [SWS_CM_10036] based on their underlying
primitive StdCppImplementationDataType (i.e., the Primitive Cpp Imple-
mentation Data Type that is defined as the underlying type of the enumeration
as defined in [SWS_LBAP_00027])⌋(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202,
RS_CM_00211)
